name: Transfer funds between a member's shares
description: Move money from one share to another for a member, walking the review screen and posting the transfer. The post is irreversible and is gated accordingly.
goal: Sign on, open member {member_id}, start a Funds Transfer from {from_share} to {to_share} for {amount} with memo {memo}, review it, and post it.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Operator ID to sign on with (e.g. teller1, super1).

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: Operator password. Supplied at invocation and never persisted.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Branch code to sign on against.

outputs.name: confirmation
outputs.description: Confirmation number issued by the host for the posted transfer.
